description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git hooks related to reference transaction handling, including setup, ref updates, hooks invocation, symbolic ref management, and transaction states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expectation

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites required for certain tests

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test suite
